concept.anchor: and the catastrophic collapse of the Tacoma Narrows bridge in 1940
concept.context: Resonance and aeroelastic flutter in the 1940 Tacoma Narrows bridge failure.

spec.title: Tacoma Narrows collapse
spec.caption: Resonance and aeroelastic flutter in the 1940 Tacoma Narrows bridge failure.
spec.body_markdown:
The 1940 collapse is usually taught as resonance, but engineers now attribute it to **aeroelastic flutter** — a self-exciting oscillation where the wind feeds energy into the twisting deck [1].

The lesson for oscillators still stands: when energy input matches the natural mode, amplitude grows until something breaks [2].
